text: My father was chief before me.
The stone heirloom has passed through Acol chiefs for generations.
My father told me: 'Never lose the stone.' He never explained why.
I was present during the final years of the Night of Ash recovery and remember burned buildings.
The temple and chief's family have disagreed for as long as I can remember.
I have never entered those chambers.
My grandfather claimed someone disappeared inside the monument long ago.
Bran believes the monument is dangerous.
Ren spends too much time studying old carvings.
Ikan wants to explore places he should avoid.
The abandoned widow asks questions that make people uncomfortable.
Old stories say the village was founded for a purpose, but nobody remembers it.
The stone heirloom feels heavier than it should.
As a child, I saw symbols carved on the underside of the heirloom, but I have never been able to find them again.
